boundaries: Classification and clause decomposition remain auditable syntactic heuristics, not semantic understanding.
The Chinese negation guard is a bounded lexical safeguard, not general Chinese negation understanding or truth adjudication.
Dynamic reinspection is structural reprioritization only; it does not decide which conflicting receipt is true.
Canonical provenance equality blocks same-source false independence inside one clause-scoped handoff, but differently named provenance values are not thereby proven independent.
Canonical provenance equality is a structural identity heuristic; it can still over-collapse genuinely distinct sources whose labels normalize to the same key.
Source-internal contradiction quarantine preserves uncertainty and prevents false escalation; it does not adjudicate which return is true.
Contamination-triage classes are host-defined structural labels and do not by themselves prove contamination, source independence, or claim truth.
Dynamic decomposition produces reversible open routing/inspection facets only; it does not close the parent conflict or claim that GUT or MU/TH/UR executed those facets.
A handoff contract is a routing request, not evidence that the target organ executed it.
Integration PASS proves the tested deterministic paths and regressions only; it does not prove general semantic dismantling quality.
Formal SHROOMING history remains distinct from deterministic repository-native probes and controls.
